name: Dry Pasta (500g)
descriptions: A 500g bag of dried durum wheat pasta (penne).
Staple dry ingredient — cooks quickly and stores well.
Used as a base for many meals when combined with sauce or olive oil.
effects: Provides a substantial base of calories when cooked or eaten as-is in a pinch.
Combines well with sauces, oils, and seasonings to form a complete meal.

name: Raw Long-Grain Rice (1kg)
descriptions: A 1kg bag of long-grain white rice.
Versatile dry grain — filling and neutral-flavored.
Good for stretching meals and pairing with canned goods or sauces.
effects: Filling carbohydrate source; pairs with proteins or vegetables.
Useful for bulk meals and porridge when extra hydration is available.

name: All-Purpose Flour (1kg bag)
descriptions: A one-kilogram sack of all-purpose wheat flour.
Used for baking, thickening, and making doughs and batters.
Large single bag — useful but slightly bulky to store.
effects: Raw flour is an ingredient rather than a finished meal; can be used to make bread or batter.
Provides modest calories if consumed as part of prepared food.

name: Granulated Sugar (500g)
descriptions: A 500g bag of granulated white sugar.
Sweetener for baking, preserves, and beverages.
Concentrated energy source when added to foods or eaten sparingly.
effects: Quick energy boost when consumed or used in cooking.
Useful for preserves, baking and sweetening drinks.

name: Sea Salt Shaker (250g)
descriptions: A 250g container of coarse sea salt.
Essential seasoning for cooking and preserving flavors.
Not typically eaten alone; used to improve taste in dishes.

name: Extra Virgin Olive Oil (500ml)
descriptions: A 500ml bottle of extra virgin olive oil.
High-quality cooking oil for dressings, sautés, and finishing dishes.
Provides concentrated calories and a smooth flavor profile.
effects: Adds richness and calories to meals; can be used raw or for cooking.
A little goes a long way for flavor and energy.

name: Canned Tomatoes (400g)
descriptions: A 400g tin of chopped canned tomatoes.
Ready-to-use for sauces, stews, and soups.
Adds acidity and body to many recipes.
effects: Provides hydration and a savory base for cooking.
Easy to combine with pasta, rice, or canned proteins.

name: Pasta Sauce Jar (680g)
descriptions: A large 680g jar of ready-made tomato pasta sauce.
Seasoned and ready to heat; convenient for quick meals.
Contains herbs and oil to round out flavor.
effects: Conveniently turns pasta or rice into a more complete meal.
Provides both flavor and modest hydration when eaten.

name: Honey Jar (250g)
descriptions: A 250g jar of raw honey.
Natural sweetener, long shelf life and concentrated calories.
Useful for tea, toast, or as a baking ingredient.
effects: Provides a sweet, quick source of energy and soothes when added to tea.
Can act as a preservative in some preserves and glazes.

name: Peanut Butter (340g)
descriptions: A 340g jar of creamy peanut butter.
Calorie-dense spread high in fats and protein.
Good for sandwiches, sauces, and adding richness to meals.
effects: Highly filling and energy-dense; excellent for quick sustenance.
Pairs with bread, crackers, or fruit preserves for a complete snack.

name: Canned Tuna in Oil (160g)
descriptions: A 160g can of tuna preserved in oil.
Ready-to-eat protein that pairs well with pasta, rice, or bread.
Shelf-stable and nutrient-dense.
effects: Provides a solid source of protein and fats; can make meals more satisfying.
Convenient for salads, sandwiches, or warmed dishes.

name: Dried Lentils (500g)
descriptions: A 500g bag of dried lentils (red/brown mix).
Cook quickly relative to other legumes; nutritious and filling.
Good base for soups, stews, and purees.
effects: High in fiber and protein; makes hearty meals when cooked.
Can be used to stretch meat or act as the main protein in vegetarian dishes.

name: Strawberry Jam Jar (340g)
descriptions: A 340g jar of strawberry jam.
Sweet fruit preserve used on bread, pastries, or as a sweetener.
Long shelf life once sealed; best refrigerated after opening.
effects: Adds sweetness and quick energy to simple staples like toast or crackers.
Useful for making simple snacks or boosting calorie content of meals.

name: Canned Beans (400g)
descriptions: A 400g can of ready-to-eat beans (e.g., kidney or cannellini).
Protein- and fiber-rich; can be added to stews, salads, or served alone.
Hearty and filling with long shelf stability.
effects: Filling and nutritious — makes a simple meal when combined with rice or bread.
Provides steady energy and satiety.

name: Dried Mixed Herbs Packet (20g)
descriptions: Small packet of dried mixed herbs (oregano, basil, thyme).
Used to season sauces, soups, and dry mixes.
Small but potent — a little elevates many dishes.

name: White Vinegar (500ml)
descriptions: A 500ml bottle of distilled white vinegar.
Used for pickling, dressings, cleaning, and flavor balancing.
Sharp acidic liquid — used more as an ingredient than a standalone food.

name: Baking Powder Tin (100g)
descriptions: A 100g tin of baking powder (leavening agent).
Essential for quick breads, cakes, and many baked goods.
Small container lasts for many bakes if kept dry.

name: Soy Sauce Bottle (150ml)
descriptions: A 150ml bottle of soy sauce — salty and umami-rich.
Common seasoning for Asian and general cooking.
Adds depth to soups, marinades, and stir-fries.
effects: Enhances savory flavor; small amount needed to season a dish.
Can be used as a condiment or a cooking ingredient.
